subject: Correction to the local-first handoff: the four cloud stages died at the 03:28Z compaction — exact state, all yours; plus the planner's 27-row inventory
body:
Correction to the 03:35Z handoff (cloud-owner-directive-03-30z-local-first-the-mac) and to heartbeat #1616: the four cloud stages described there as "finishing" did not finish. Every in-process cloud agent died at 03:28:39Z, when the coordinating session's context was compacted (each agent transcript's last write carries that same second; no output was produced after it). Under the owner's local-first directive the cloud has NOT restarted any of them. Their exact state, and what is yours now:
(1) PR #1586 claude/build-gate-symlink-entry-guard @ 6d11676 — the round-8 LANDING REFUTE is not done (the agent died with an empty scratch). CI is all green on the head (gating 120212588268, Mac-only 120212587799, CodeQL 120213293406), round-8 comment 6356200795, merge-tree clean. The landing refute is yours; on your ship verdict (a comment on the PR, or a lane message) the cloud lands it under DR-037 with a merged-under line naming those three check-run ids. After it lands, #1611 needs mainline re-merged (it conflicts in docs/BUILD_BACKLOG.md and docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md; regenerate the coverage page with the tool).
(2) claude/build-tick-followup-1593 @ 3f96ff271890851377f254929e563b8c4ecc4013 (on the Hub) — round 3 is BUILT, the round-3 REVIEW is not done and no PR is open. The builder's report quotes, on that head: `Preflight PASSED — everything it runs is green.`, `Breadth lane PASSED — 58 breadth proofs green`, `followup passed (149/149)`, `self-test passed (393/393)`; heartbeatSince in the last commit is 2026-10-23T01:57Z. Round-3 content: R2-1 the installer resolves runner and PATH-prefix paths with `cd -P` so a symlinked directory plus `..` cannot escape the outside-the-checkout rule; R2-2 `triage_step()` runs under the exit trap (TERM during triage takes the triage session down and releases the lock); I1 the trap's "failed: the run ended without a result" heartbeat bypasses the 15-minute hold once (a repeat inside the hour is still held); I2 `bt_kill_tree` lists the tree first and signals from the top; I3 a named pulse/ref-lock ceiling. Open ceilings the builder named: bash 3.2 was not run (bash 5.2 here; the darwin block ran under emulation); the installer does not scan PATH-prefix directory contents (time-of-check/time-of-use). The files are Mac-owned (scripts/mac/build-tick.sh, the installer, the registry row — the rule-2 announcement went out in #1610). Yours: review it, open the PR (or ask the cloud to open it with this body), re-stamp heartbeatSince in your last commit and land within 3 h of it; the cloud lands it under DR-037 on your ship verdict.
(3) claude/build-local-brain-capabilities — the round-3 BUILDER died with four files edited and uncommitted (+1382/-386: scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities.mjs, scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities-mutants.mjs, scripts/mac/local-brain/CAPABILITIES.md, scripts/mac/local-brain/capabilities.json). So the work is not lost when the cloud container is reclaimed, the cloud committed them AS A LABELLED WIP (commit 122184395655 "WIP local-brain round 3: the cloud builder's uncommitted edits at the 03:28Z stop (unverified, handed to the Mac lane)") and pushed; the Hub tip is now 122184395655. Measured on that tree at 04:40Z, verbatim: `PASS  local-brain capabilities self-test - 192 planted violations across 10 rules each failed their own check …`; `OK local-brain capabilities - 74 rows (allowed 37, own-worktree 9, own-worktree-host-lock 6, owner-grant 8, cloud-model 4, forbidden 10) …`; `OK mutants: 235/235 killed (186 code, 49 data); 1 documented equivalent survived`. NOT reviewed, preflight and breadth NOT run on it. The round-2 findings it was fixing: M1 an anchor does not turn a moved range citation red though the header, contract and OK line say it does; M2 21 mutants of the gate's own checks survived (2 fail-open); L1 forbidden patterns miss literal spellings their rows name; L2 the mutant harness leaks its temp dir; L3 R9 does not scan all generated text; L4 R2 reads only the first program of a command line. Yours from here: verify which of those the WIP closes, finish, gates, PR. The OWNER_DECISION draft (whether the brain may land code itself) stays the owner's; never merged by a lane.
(4) The planner (read-only) died after writing its inventory and before its prioritized list. Its inventory, measured on 808ee24c: 27 open rows this lane can build end to end, 167 excluded (lab, Swift, device, owner decision, decision-core returns, open PR, Mac claim), 1 Mac claim (17c).
